requirement: A changed term counts as a change the tests did not make
scenario: A promise re-opened through another term's definition keys the definition it never names
note: The THEN promises the promise is pending AGAIN, but the proof never asserts the review settled it in between - no check that pending dropped to 1 after the review, before REPLY is redefined a second time. Pending 2 at the end also matches a world where recording a review never clears pending, so the claimed re-opening is indistinguishable from the promise never having stopped being pending. The gate (exit 1) holds regardless, since the unreviewed sibling scenario keeps it shut

note: The THEN promises the scenario is gathered ONCE, but the proof only takes report.scenarios.find (the first match) and asserts that record's changed and reopenedBy - nothing pins the length or shape of report.scenarios, so a tool that gathered the promise twice (once per axis) would still pass
